summary.result: The results of this study are intended to be used as an example of calculating GHG emissions for downstream processes of domestic agricultural products, prior to estimating and regulating the carbon footprint of imported agricultural products in line with the global issue of imposing carbon tax on imported goods between countries.
summary.background: The subjects of the study were apples, and the life cycle assessment was conducted under the assumption of fresh food (agricultural products processed products).
summary.method: Accordingly, the result shows that the distribution phase has the largest impact on the life cycle for the apple.
